finding: Target has four floppy descriptors immediately followed by 25 hard-drive descriptors; relocation moved the array into BIOS_DATA to reproduce their order. The old msinit memory-retention boundary assumptions need a target-backed update later; the target mapping of the array alone does not validate the whole initializer. Subsequent device-header and segment analysis showed that contiguity alone did not justify moving the array to BIOS_DATA; that move was reverted.
link_fields: The nine differences occupy three relocated far pointers; their offsets and segment values depend on pending target-wide layout.
memory_boundary_dependency: bios/msinit.asm static_configure and endfloppy/end96tpi/end_of_bdss logic must be reconstructed before treating BIOS initialization as complete.
